Privacy.metaDescription: What the Pact application asks for, why it is used, and how to ask for a correction or deletion.
Privacy.title: Privacy notice
Privacy.intro: This notice explains what the application to join the Pact for the Development of the Aerospace Sector in the State of Puebla asks for, and why.
Privacy.responsible: Clúster de Startups e Innovación, A.C., in Heroica Puebla de Zaragoza, Puebla, Mexico, is responsible. For any question about this data, write to secretariado@clusterdestartups.org.
Privacy.data: Organization, agency, company, or initiative; type of organization; name of the representative with legal authority; email; phone; why you want to join; what you bring to the aerospace ecosystem; what commitments you intend to take on; and your acceptance of this notice.
Privacy.purpose: To record your interest in joining the Pact and to email you, at the address you gave, the instructions for the letter of adhesion: who it is addressed to, the format, and the deadline. A copy of what you wrote goes to secretariado@clusterdestartups.org for follow-up.
Privacy.delivery: This page is a static site. FormSubmit (formsubmit.co) delivers the data by email to the Cluster and sends you the automatic reply with the instructions. The data is not sold and is not used for third-party advertising.
Privacy.rights: You can ask to access, correct, or delete your data, or object to its use, by writing to secretariado@clusterdestartups.org. The checkbox on the form is your consent to this notice.
